court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: IV Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Chennai, O.P.No.2076 of 2019 and O.P.No.1661 of 2020
facts_of_case: The parties were married on 23.11.2017. The husband filed for restitution of conjugal rights under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The wife filed for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ia) and 12(i)(c ) of Hindu Marriage Act, for cruelty and direction to deliver jewels, silver and other movables presented by her parents.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has been guilty of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has been guilty of cruelty.
use_in: divorce cases involving allegations of cruelty

outcome.result: Appeal disposed of in terms of Joint Memo of Compromise
outcome.final_order: The parties settled the matter and a decree was passed in terms of the Joint Memo of Compromise dated 09.11.2022.

use_for_drafting: advising on Hindu Marriage Act provisions
representing clients in Family Court matters
